headline: Butterfly ranges shift worldwide amid climate change, with most species expanding their reach

Because many species exhibited multiple types of range shifts, the percentages for expansions, contractions and elevation changes are above 100%.

headline: Creating cleaner chemical reactions that run on oxygen and produce only water as waste

In nature, specialized proteins called enzymes can activate oxygen on demand by first rearranging its electrons.
